as_told.title: Lockheed neural-interface patents under John Norseen and the Battelle study

plain: An engineer named John Norsine is said to hold a patent, which Michels calls "locked", for "essentially how to fly a UFO with your mind." Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. In a later episode he adds that the patents, which he ties to the arms maker Lockheed, involve "neural imprints and neural interfaces for flying aircraft", and that a study he credits to Battelle looked at the same idea in the early 2020s. If true, it would mean someone had worked out on paper how to steer a craft with thought alone.
